title: Abundance Nurse Staffing System
headline: Abundance now has a repo-backed database, API/MCP-facing contract surface, and matching-agent boundary that can be delivered as a visible client update instead of a loose status note.

notionContext.engagementTitle: The NP Group — Abundance AI-native staffing pipeline

summary: The project has moved from concept into a concrete operating system shape: profile data, matching data, intake history, API routes, an OpenAPI contract, and a client-facing explanation layer all live in the monorepo.

The current delivery should show the relationship between the created database, the API/MCP surface, and the agent behavior: what the system stores, what tools can be called, and where human review still belongs.
The client-ready message should avoid internal tool sprawl. It should say: the nurse intake and matching workflow now has durable data, callable actions, and explainable recommendations.

components.label: Created DB
components.title: D1 schema for profiles, intakes, and matches
components.summary: The Abundance database model captures seekers/open demand, talent/nurse-side supply, matches, and intake history. The schema is intentionally small so the workflow can be explained and audited.

components.label: MCP/API surface
components.title: Callable Abundance actions for agents and workflow tools
components.summary: The Abundance API has route handlers and an OpenAPI contract that can be exposed through the CREATE SOMETHING MCP hub or consumed by agent tools. A dedicated Abundance MCP wrapper remains the clean hardening step if MCP-native access becomes the delivery standard.

components.label: Matching agent
components.title: Agent boundary for intake, shortlist, and escalation
components.summary: The matching logic can produce an explainable shortlist using skills, budget, and availability. The client-facing agent rule is recommendation support, not autonomous staffing decisions.

clientUpdate: We have the first durable Abundance system shape in place: a database for nurse/candidate-side profile history and matching state, callable workflow routes for intake and match creation, and a matching layer that returns visible reasons rather than black-box decisions.

The current implementation supports the core operating path: capture profile context, preserve intake history, create or update demand/supply records, generate suggested matches, and keep the recruiter/human review boundary visible.
The next useful review is not another brainstorm. It is a walkthrough of the DB, callable actions, and agent recommendation boundary using the generated delivery images below.
nextReview: Confirm whether the client-facing vocabulary should stay nurse staffing-specific or preserve the generic Seeker/Talent/Match API names underneath.
Decide whether to ship a dedicated Abundance MCP package now or keep the current OpenAPI-plus-hub route until the client workflow stabilizes.
Capture real screenshots from the deployed presentation/control surface once the client-visible route is promoted.

outputs.title: Abundance Image 2 Delivery Graph
outputs.prompt: Create a polished editorial infographic for a client project update titled "Abundance Nurse Staffing System". Show a left-to-right operating path with three large labeled stages: "Created DB", "MCP/API Surface", and "Matching Agent". Under Created DB, visualize structured records for nurse profiles, job demand, intakes, and matches. Under MCP/API Surface, visualize callable tools, API contract, and controlled access. Under Matching Agent, visualize explainable recommendations, missing-info flags, and human recruiter review. Style: premium SaaS operations diagram, restrained color, crisp typography, calm professional delivery, light background, no stock photography, no real people, no PHI, no client secrets, no fake screenshots. The image should feel client-ready and make the relationship between database, MCP/API, and agent obvious.

outputs.title: Abundance Image 2 Evidence Map
outputs.prompt: Create a polished client-facing evidence map titled "Abundance Project Evidence". Show three proof lanes labeled "Database", "Automation", and "Judgment". Database lane should represent schema, D1 tables, profile history, intakes, and matches. Automation lane should represent API routes, OpenAPI contract, MCP-ready tool surface, and workflow calls. Judgment lane should represent matching logic, fit-score explanation, escalation, and recruiter approval. Include visual proof cards and connector lines, but avoid tiny unreadable file paths. Style: editorial technical diagram, clean modern layout, practical consulting delivery artifact, muted neutral background with teal, blue, and amber accents, no real people, no sensitive data, no fake UI screenshots, no watermarks.
